messages:
maria: quick one — customer reported blocked writes after a proxy rotation. sticky cookie hit a pod that had moved regions, legal guard denied. anyone familiar?
ajay: yup. happened in a staging canary when pods got rescheduled across AZs but cookies pointed to instance id.
leila: is fast-rotate (no-drain) still enabled? that would explain it.
samir: correct. fast-rotate trades drain for speed; assumes session-level residency info is implicit. bug when server enforces residency.
maria: surface area: we rely on instance tags for region; need an explicit session residency assertion.
ajay: short fix: disable fast-rotate for tenants with residency=STRICT. low risk.
leila: long-term: control-plane-issued signed "residency lease" in header/cookie. proxies validate sig + ttl before accepting writes.
samir: implement ed25519-signed blob, TTL ~ 3m, proxies cache leases per-session. issuer rotates keys with overlap.
maria: ops question: default-on-failure? EU clusters should default-deny for compliance; global clusters maybe log-only then allow.
leila: add a canary mode: log-only for 48h, then enforce for a subset of tenants. legal to define "region" taxonomy in RFC.
ajay: I'll prototype a tiny verifier in proxy runtime (2d). samir, can you spec issuer API + runbook?
samir: on it. will include load test for verify latency and cache hit ratios.
sre-bot: Canary report: fast-rotate produced 0.12% residency-mismatch in staging-2, auto-rollback triggered.
maria: action items: RFC draft (maria), proxy lib spike (ajay), issuer API + runbook (samir), compliance notes (leila). I'll open ops PR to force-drain STRICT tenants today.
